masking.COMMON_CORE: uniform scientific-identity-keyed subset of exactly 8,593 common-core addresses is target; complementary 8,593 are student-visible
masking.OPERATOR_NATIVE: scientific-identity-keyed subset of floor(native_only/2) native addresses is target; all common core plus complementary native addresses are student-visible
masking.reference_rng: SHA256 rank over masking_seed/base_presentation_index/stable_cell_key/draw/family/canonical_address; optimizer update index, tensor row, device and microbatch are excluded; reference-only until a production mask kernel independently qualifies
masking.why_half: maximum-symmetry split inside each selected support family; no inherited V4 40% mechanics constant

mass_proof: For either family f, weight |f|/M times uniform exact-half inclusion k/|f| times singleton mean 1/k = 1/M for every measured address. Summing the two stratified family contributions preserves one unit of base-view mass per cell.

stratified_view_schedule.rule: evaluate each of the two dataset-defined support families exactly once per base presentation
stratified_view_schedule.why_not_equal_family_mass: common/native support sizes differ by operator; equal family mass would redefine measured-address prevalence
stratified_view_schedule.why_not_sample_one_family: stratification removes avoidable family-selection variance/coverage failure while preserving exact measured-address target mass

student_views.COMMON_CORE: student sees the complementary common-core half only; operator-native addresses are excluded from this anchor view
student_views.OPERATOR_NATIVE: student sees all common core plus the complementary operator-native half

support_families.COMMON_CORE: exact 17,186 addresses measured scalar in all 42 reader-fit operators
support_families.OPERATOR_NATIVE: operator measured-scalar support minus the exact common core

teacher_view: ALL_NATIVE_MEASURED_SCALAR_ADDRESSES for BOTH families; teacher support is never reduced to common-core-only
